newsitem.title: SWEDEN: EU countries to meet on CSD federation on Monday.
newsitem.headline: EU countries to meet on CSD federation on Monday.

text.p: European Union countries' central securities depositories (CSDs) will meet next week to discuss creating a federation, Sweden's CSD, Vardepapperscentralen (VPC), said on Thursday.
"EU CSDs will meet on Monday in Stockholm and they could decide to create a federation," Elias Kazarian, executive principle advisor at VPC, told Reuters.
The 13 depositories would link electronically without having any head office, he said.
"Thereby a German could register a trade he has done on the Stockholm bourse with the German CSD," Kazarian said.
All the CSDs register trading in equity and debt instruments, while some also handle clearing.
Kazarian added that while the EU has 15 members, there were only 13 CSDs as Ireland operates via Britain and Luxembourg via Belgium.
The linking of the CSDs would be in line with a future electronic linkage of European bourses, which among others the head of the Stockholm Stock Exchange, Bengt Ryden, expects to happen.
